author: Yffe
content: Source: thermite-syntax lex_int strips '_' and accumulates into Token::Int(u128); AST Expr::IntLit(u128) (ast.rs) carries no raw text, so thermite-lower cannot reproduce separators. Numerically 1000000 == 1_000_000 — NO contract weakening, verus verifies (R-DEFER-9 satisfied). Diverges only from REQ-3's cosmetic parenthetical 'underscores preserved verbatim'; AMENDED REQ-8/AC verify emitted output (passes) and require contract equivalence (holds). Owner: thermite-syntax (representation), not thermite-lower. Low priority per goal.md S8. No failing test filed: there is no soundness divergence to pin (R-CHAR-3 — would be a tautological/cosmetic assertion).
